[SWS_UCM_00286] Software Cluster life-cycle state transition from kRemoved to kPresent in case of Finish call
⌈
A Software Cluster state shall
change from kRemoved to kPresent after a successful call to Finish method in case
a Software Cluster being removed has to be rolled back after a failing activation.
⌋
